title.narrative: Strengthening indigenous communities' participation in the pan-amazonian synod

description.narrative: The project aims to achieve increased participation of Amazonian indigenous communities in the preparation process for the Amazonian synod in 2019, to enable their voices to be heard and for the Amazonian church to be focussed on indigenous peoples, as described by Pope Francis. This project wants to achieve a substantive change, consolidating an intercultural dialogue between indigenous peoples and the Amazonian church through the active participation of indigenous leaders alongside diocesan pastoral teams in the amazon during preparatory activities for the Pan-Amazonian synod in 2019. It aims to train Amazonian pastoral team members on the critical problems the Amazon is facing, to improve the protection of the Amazon and the indigenous peoples that live there. The project will aim to enable indigenous people to advocate on their own behalves, using their own words. Communications materials will be produced (including radio programmes) by indigenous people in indigenous languages to strengthen participation of the indigenous communities and to adhere more closely to the teachings of the church which should, in Pope Francis' words, have an "indigenous face".
